messages:
laura (product): FYI, ACME renewal checklist just landed. They want 99.95% uptime for hosted API and p95 request latency < 200ms across EU/US. Need routing/escalation plan.

mike (sales): they attached the SOW. Renewal date is 2026-05-15. This is a gating item for renewal — legal will push if we don't commit.

anita (support): ticket #8742 has the recent incidents they've seen. Mostly spikes during batch ingests from their analytics pipeline. Current p95 in eu-west is ~280ms on peak.

sam (eng): 200ms p95 is doable but requires reserving dedicated capacity or tuning batching and cache for their traffic pattern. If they need hosted SLA we should consider a reserved pool + route policy.

evan (eng-sre): agree with Sam. Also need explicit escalation path and on-call SL for outages. We should propose a runbook. Short draft:

```
- Primary: routed to eng-sre on-call (pager)
- 30 min: notify account lead + CSM
- 90 min: open critical incident bridge + exec report
- Fallback: failover to compatible model in another region
```

mike (sales): can we map this to our Dedicated contract offering? they'll pay for a predictable commit. If so, please give a delta estimate and rollout lead time.

sam (eng): rough estimate: 2x p4d-equivalent capacity in eu-west plus autoscale buffers. Provisioning lead time ~3 weeks once PO hits. Short-term we can offer a soft SLA with routing + throttling to reduce spikes.

anita (support): we need an internal escalation matrix (who is notified after eng-sre, who handles customer comms). Also need a support tier add-on for faster response windows.

laura (product): OK. Proposal we present to ACME next week:
- Option A: Dedicated reserved pool (SLA: 99.95%, p95 <200ms) — 3-week lead time, additional monthly commit
- Option B: Hosted + enhanced monitoring & priority routing (soft SLA, best-effort, 1-week config)
- Include runbook and 24/7 escalation for Option A only

evan (eng-sre): I'll draft the runbook and escalation matrix. Will also add alert thresholds and escalation times.

sam (eng): I'll work with infra to get a capacity quote and pricing delta.

mike (sales): I'll own the commercial wording and speak with legal on SLA terms.

jira-bot: Created ticket RED-3217: "ACME SLA intake — options + runbook" assigned to laura, sam, evan, priority: high.

laura (product): Great. Action items: evan runbook by Thu, sam capacity quote by Fri, mike commercial draft by Fri EOD. Sync 30m Friday to finalize slides for ACME. @anita please prep incident history summary for the slide deck.

anita (support): on it. I'll export last 90 days and annotate root causes.

mike (sales): thanks everyone. If we can land Option A before renewal it'll be a big win. :thumbsup:

laura (product): assigning follow-ups in RED-3217. Leaving thread open for updates.
